parameters.name: Ownership and control
parameters.formula_text: Ownership % = Parent-owned shares ÷ Total subsidiary shares × 100. Also calculate Voting Control % = Parent-controlled votes ÷ Total votes × 100. Use the higher-risk result.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 20%, no influence. 2: 20% to below 30%. 3: 30% to below 50%, significant influence. 4: 50% to below 75%, majority control. 5: 75% or more, or unilateral control.

parameters.name: Subsidiary financial materiality
parameters.formula_text: Revenue Share = Subsidiary revenue ÷ Group revenue × 100. Asset Share = Subsidiary assets ÷ Group assets × 100. EBITDA Share = Subsidiary EBITDA ÷ Group EBITDA × 100. Financial Materiality = 40% Revenue Share + 30% Asset Share + 30% EBITDA Share.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Parent exposure and support
parameters.formula_text: Support Exposure = Equity investment + Intercompany loans + Receivables + Guarantees + Expected support. Exposure Ratio = Support Exposure ÷ Parent adjusted capital × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 2%. 2: 2% to below 5%. 3: 5% to below 10%. 4: 10% to below 20%. 5: 20% or more.

parameters.name: Effective ultimate ownership
parameters.formula_text: Effective Ownership % = Ownership percentage at Layer 1 × Layer 2 × remaining layers. Example: 80% × 60% = 48%. Add parallel ownership paths where legally appropriate.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 20%. 3: 20% to below 30%. 4: 30% to below 50%. 5: 50% or more.

parameters.name: Voting and control rights
parameters.formula_text: Control Coverage % = Voting rights controlled + equivalent board or reserved-matter control, converted to an approved 0 to 100 control measure. Use the strongest verified control right.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: No control. 2: Minor protective rights. 3: Significant influence. 4: De facto control or major veto. 5: Absolute or unilateral control.

parameters.name: Ownership-path complexity
parameters.formula_text: Complexity Index = Additional ownership layers + 2 × Nominee/trust arrangements + 2 × Unverified entities + Higher-risk jurisdiction points.     ( It is multiplied by 2 because nominee or trust arrangements and unverified entities are being treated as twice as significant as a normal ownership layer. The number 2 is a chosen risk weight, not a mandatory regulatory constant.)
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: 0 to 1 point. 2: 2 to 3. 3: 4 to 5. 4: 6 to 8. 5: Above 8 or a material part of the path is unverified.

parameters.name: Common shareholder holding
parameters.formula_text: Common Holding % = Minimum of shareholder ownership in Entity A and shareholder ownership in Entity B.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 20%. 3: 20% to below 30%. 4: 30% to below 50%. 5: 50% or more.

parameters.name: Common control rights
parameters.formula_text: Control Coverage % = Shared shareholder-controlled board seats or voting rights ÷ Relevant total seats or votes × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 20%. 3: 20% to below 35%. 4: 35% to below 50%. 5: 50% or more.

parameters.name: Intercompany dependency
parameters.formula_text: Dependency % = Transactions + Funding + Guarantees between linked entities ÷ Relevant revenue, funding, or debt total × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Board overlap
parameters.formula_text: Board Overlap % = Number of shared directors ÷ Number of directors on the smaller board × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 20%. 3: 20% to below 35%. 4: 35% to below 50%. 5: 50% or more.

parameters.name: Decision authority
parameters.formula_text: Decision Authority % = Critical decision areas controlled by shared persons ÷ Total defined critical decision areas × 100. Areas may include finance, risk, strategy, procurement, and operations.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 25%. 3: 25% to below 50%. 4: 50% to below 75%. 5: 75% or more.

parameters.name: Overlapping tenure
parameters.formula_text: Overlap Tenure = Minimum active overlapping appointment period across the two entities.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Inactive or below 3 months. 2: 3 months to below 1 year. 3: 1 to below 3 years. 4: 3 to below 5 years. 5: 5 years or more.

parameters.name: Formal group classification
parameters.formula_text: Classification Rating = Approved rating mapped from the bank’s formal group type and grouping rationale.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Informational group. 2: Candidate group under review. 3: Approved borrower group. 4: Approved economic group. 5: Regulatory connected group.

parameters.name: Group EAD concentration
parameters.formula_text: Group EAD Concentration % = Connected Group EAD ÷ Relevant portfolio EAD × 100. A capital-based denominator may also be used under policy.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Intra-group financial dependency
parameters.formula_text: Dependency % = Intra-group funding + Guarantees + Cash-pool balances ÷ Group funding or debt × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Guarantee coverage
parameters.formula_text: Guarantee Coverage % = Enforceable guarantee amount ÷ Supported exposure × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 25%. 3: 25% to below 50%. 4: 50% to below 80%. 5: 80% or more.

parameters.name: Guarantor burden
parameters.formula_text: Guarantor Burden % = Total potential guarantee calls ÷ Guarantor adjusted capital × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Borrower support dependency
parameters.formula_text: Support Dependency % = Funding supported by guarantor ÷ Total borrower funding × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 25%. 3: 25% to below 50%. 4: 50% to below 80%. 5: 80% or more.

parameters.name: Cross-guarantee coverage
parameters.formula_text: Coverage % = Cross-guaranteed obligations ÷ Combined entity debt × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 25%. 3: 25% to below 50%. 4: 50% to below 80%. 5: 80% or more.

parameters.name: Guarantee-chain complexity
parameters.formula_text: Complexity Score = Number of guarantee links + 3 points for a circular guarantee + 2 points for each unresolved legal link.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: One simple link. 2: Two links. 3: Three links. 4: Four or more non-circular links. 5: Circular, opaque, or unresolved chain.

parameters.name: Joint guarantee burden
parameters.formula_text: Joint Burden % = Potential calls across the guarantee network ÷ Combined adjusted capital of guarantors × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Collateral utilisation
parameters.formula_text: Collateral Utilisation % = Total secured claims ÷ Eligible collateral value after approved haircut × 100.

parameters.name: Shared-asset concentration
parameters.formula_text: Concentration % = Largest shared asset value ÷ Total eligible collateral value × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 20%. 3: 20% to below 35%. 4: 35% to below 50%. 5: 50% or more.

parameters.name: Collateral risk adjustment
parameters.formula_text: Collateral Risk % = Approved market haircut + Valuation-age adjustment + Lien/legal-priority adjustment.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 20%. 3: 20% to below 35%. 4: 35% to below 50%. 5: 50% or more, or unperfected/disputed collateral.

parameters.name: Ownership and control
parameters.formula_text: JV Control % = Highest of ownership percentage, voting-right percentage, or board-control percentage.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 20%. 3: 20% to below 50%, influence only. 4: Joint control. 5: Dominant or de facto control.

parameters.name: Capital commitment
parameters.formula_text: Commitment Ratio % = Equity commitment + Shareholder loans + Guarantees ÷ Investor adjusted capital × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 2%. 2: 2% to below 5%. 3: 5% to below 10%. 4: 10% to below 20%. 5: 20% or more.

parameters.name: Strategic cash-flow dependency
parameters.formula_text: Dependency % = Revenue, purchases, dividends, or off-take linked to JV ÷ Relevant entity total × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Facility materiality
parameters.formula_text: Facility Exposure = Drawn amount + Undrawn commitment × CCF. Facility Materiality % = Facility Exposure ÷ Total borrower debt × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Covenant/default linkage
parameters.formula_text: Default Linkage % = Debt subject to cross-default or acceleration ÷ Total borrower debt × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 25%. 3: 25% to below 50%. 4: 50% to below 80%. 5: 80% or more, or automatic cross-default.

parameters.name: Refinancing proximity
parameters.formula_text: Months to Maturity = Facility maturity date minus calculation date, converted into months.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: More than 36 months. 2: 24 to 36 months. 3: 12 to below 24 months. 4: 6 to below 12 months. 5: Below 6 months.

parameters.name: Head-office funding dependency
parameters.formula_text: Funding Dependency % = Net funding received from head office ÷ Branch total funding × 100. Legal status acts as an override where the branch and head office are the same legal entity.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10% and legally separate. 2: 10% to below 25%. 3: 25% to below 50%. 4: 50% to below 80%. 5: 80% or more, or the same legal entity.

parameters.name: Branch financial materiality
parameters.formula_text: Materiality % = 40% Branch Asset Share + 30% Branch Revenue Share + 30% Branch EAD Share.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Jurisdiction and transfer risk
parameters.formula_text: Jurisdiction Score = Approved country, transfer, convertibility, ring-fencing, and resolution-risk score normalized to 0 to 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: 0 to below 20. 2: 20 to below 40. 3: 40 to below 60. 4: 60 to below 80. 5: 80 to 100 or blocked transfer.

parameters.name: Purchase dependency
parameters.formula_text: Purchase Dependency % = Purchases from supplier ÷ Total purchases × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Supplier replacement time
parameters.formula_text: Replacement Time = Estimated months required to qualify, contract, and activate an alternative supplier.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 1 month. 2: 1 to below 3 months. 3: 3 to below 6 months. 4: 6 to below 12 months. 5: 12 months or more, or no alternative supplier.

parameters.name: Production dependency
parameters.formula_text: Production Dependency % = Output dependent on supplier input ÷ Total output × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 25%. 3: 25% to below 50%. 4: 50% to below 75%. 5: 75% or more, or production stops without the supplier.

parameters.name: Revenue concentration
parameters.formula_text: Revenue Concentration % = Revenue from customer ÷ Total revenue × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Receivables concentration
parameters.formula_text: Receivables Concentration % = Receivables from customer ÷ Total receivables × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Overdue receivables
parameters.formula_text: Overdue Ratio % = Customer receivables overdue beyond approved period ÷ Total receivables from customer × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more, or specifically impaired.

parameters.name: Path dependency
parameters.formula_text: Path Dependency % = Dependency at Edge 1 × Dependency at Edge 2 × remaining edge dependencies. Example: 60% × 50% = 30%.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 2%. 2: 2% to below 5%. 3: 5% to below 10%. 4: 10% to below 20%. 5: 20% or more.

parameters.name: Critical-node concentration
parameters.formula_text: Node Concentration % = Critical supply paths passing through node ÷ Total identified critical paths × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Supply-path depth
parameters.formula_text: Path Depth = Number of relationship edges in the shortest relevant supply path.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: More than 5 tiers. 2: 4 to 5 tiers. 3: 3 tiers. 4: 2 tiers. 5: Direct or near-direct critical dependency.

parameters.name: Funding dependency
parameters.formula_text: Funding Dependency % = Funding from shared provider or market ÷ Total funding × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Refinancing proximity
parameters.formula_text: Months to Refinancing = Refinancing date minus calculation date, converted into months.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: More than 36 months. 2: 24 to 36 months. 3: 12 to below 24 months. 4: 6 to below 12 months. 5: Below 6 months.

parameters.name: Alternative funding coverage
parameters.formula_text: Coverage % = Available alternative lines + Unrestricted liquidity ÷ Funding due within 12 months × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: 150% or more. 2: 120% to below 150%. 3: 100% to below 120%. 4: 75% to below 100%. 5: Below 75%.

parameters.name: Sponsor ownership and control
parameters.formula_text: Sponsor Control % = Highest ownership percentage, voting-right percentage, or board-control percentage.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 20%. 3: 20% to below 50%, significant influence. 4: Joint or de facto control. 5: Majority control.

parameters.name: Sponsor funding dependency
parameters.formula_text: Funding Dependency % = Sponsor equity + Shareholder loans + Sponsor guarantees ÷ Total entity funding × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Portfolio correlation
parameters.formula_text: Portfolio Correlation % = Portfolio companies sharing the same primary sector, geography, or funding strategy ÷ Total relevant portfolio companies × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 25%. 3: 25% to below 50%. 4: 50% to below 75%. 5: 75% or more.

parameters.name: Payment-flow materiality
parameters.formula_text: Flow Materiality % = Payment value with connected entity ÷ Total relevant inflows or outflows × 100. Calculate inflows and outflows separately and use the relevant risk direction.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Payment persistence
parameters.formula_text: Persistence % = Months with qualifying payment activity ÷ Months in observation window × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 20%. 2: 20% to below 40%. 3: 40% to below 60%. 4: 60% to below 80%. 5: 80% or more.

parameters.name: Payment-flow disruption
parameters.formula_text: Flow Reduction % = Historical average flow minus current flow ÷ Historical average flow × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more, or flow has stopped.

parameters.name: Net exposure materiality
parameters.formula_text: Net Exposure = Current Exposure + Potential Future Exposure - Eligible Collateral. Exposure Ratio % = Net Exposure ÷ Approved counterparty limit or capital measure × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 2%. 2: 2% to below 5%. 3: 5% to below 10%. 4: 10% to below 20%. 5: 20% or more.

parameters.name: Wrong-way-risk ratio
parameters.formula_text: Wrong-way Risk % = Exposure positively linked to the counterparty’s stress factors ÷ Total net exposure × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more, or specific wrong-way risk exists.

parameters.name: Unsecured exposure
parameters.formula_text: Unsecured Exposure % = Exposure not covered by enforceable netting or eligible collateral ÷ Gross exposure × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 25%. 3: 25% to below 50%. 4: 50% to below 75%. 5: 75% or more.

parameters.name: Critical workload dependency
parameters.formula_text: Workload Dependency % = Critical business operations supported by provider ÷ Total critical operations × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 20%. 3: 20% to below 35%. 4: 35% to below 50%. 5: 50% or more.

parameters.name: Provider replacement time
parameters.formula_text: Replacement Time = Estimated months required to contract, migrate, test, and activate an approved alternative.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 1 month. 2: 1 to below 3 months. 3: 3 to below 6 months. 4: 6 to below 12 months. 5: 12 months or more, or no alternative.

parameters.name: Critical service failure rate
parameters.formula_text: Failure Rate % = Critical SLA(Service Level Agreement) failures ÷ Total measured critical SLA obligations × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 1%. 2: 1% to below 3%. 3: 3% to below 5%. 4: 5% to below 10%. 5: 10% or more, or an ongoing critical outage.

parameters.name: Coverage dependency
parameters.formula_text: Coverage Dependency % = Protected exposure ÷ Gross exposure × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 25%. 3: 25% to below 50%. 4: 50% to below 80%. 5: 80% or more.

parameters.name: Provider capacity burden
parameters.formula_text: Capacity Burden % = Estimated correlated claims ÷ Provider available claims-paying capacity × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Policy-expiry proximity
parameters.formula_text: Months to Expiry = Policy expiry date minus calculation date, converted into months.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: More than 36 months. 2: 24 to 36 months. 3: 12 to below 24 months. 4: 3 to below 12 months. 5: Below 3 months, or no replacement cover

parameters.name: Sector concentration
parameters.formula_text: Sector Concentration % = Revenue or EBITDA from sector ÷ Total revenue or EBITDA × 100. Use the most relevant measure for the business model.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 20%. 3: 20% to below 35%. 4: 35% to below 50%. 5: 50% or more.

parameters.name: Sector demand decline
parameters.formula_text: Demand Decline % = Historical sector demand minus current sector demand ÷ Historical sector demand × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Entity resilience coverage
parameters.formula_text: Resilience Coverage % = Unrestricted liquidity + Available committed lines ÷ Stressed 12-month cash requirement × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: 150% or more. 2: 120% to below 150%. 3: 100% to below 120%. 4: 75% to below 100%. 5: Below 75%.

parameters.name: Geographic concentration
parameters.formula_text: Geographic Concentration % = 40% Revenue Share + 30% Asset Share + 30% Supplier or Operational Share in the geography.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 20%. 3: 20% to below 35%. 4: 35% to below 50%. 5: 50% or more.

parameters.name: Country-risk score
parameters.formula_text: Country Risk Score = Approved sovereign, macroeconomic, transfer, political, climate, and security risk score normalized to 0 to 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: 0 to below 20. 2: 20 to below 40. 3: 40 to below 60. 4: 60 to below 80. 5: 80 to 100.

parameters.name: Unmitigated geographic exposure
parameters.formula_text: Unmitigated Exposure % = Exposure not covered by insurance, hedging, or alternative operations ÷ Total geographic exposure × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 25%. 3: 25% to below 50%. 4: 50% to below 75%. 5: 75% or more.

parameters.name: Shipment concentration
parameters.formula_text: Shipment Concentration % = Shipment volume or value through shared node ÷ Total shipment volume or value × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 20%. 3: 20% to below 35%. 4: 35% to below 50%. 5: 50% or more.

parameters.name: Diversion coverage
parameters.formula_text: Diversion Coverage % = Available alternative route capacity ÷ Volume dependent on shared node × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: 100% or more. 2: 75% to below 100%. 3: 50% to below 75%. 4: 25% to below 50%. 5: Below 25%.

parameters.name: Inventory buffer
parameters.formula_text: Inventory Buffer Ratio = Inventory days available ÷ Expected disruption days.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: 3.0 or more. 2: 2.0 to below 3.0. 3: 1.0 to below 2.0. 4: 0.5 to below 1.0. 5: Below 0.5

parameters.name: Commodity dependency
parameters.formula_text: Commodity Dependency % = Commodity-related cost or revenue ÷ Total cost or revenue × 100. Select cost or revenue according to whether the entity is a consumer or producer.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 20%. 3: 20% to below 35%. 4: 35% to below 50%. 5: 50% or more.

parameters.name: Price-shock impact
parameters.formula_text: Price-shock Impact % = Absolute stressed EBITDA reduction ÷ Base EBITDA × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Unhedged exposure
parameters.formula_text: Unhedged Exposure % = Commodity volume or value not effectively hedged ÷ Total commodity exposure × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 20%. 2: 20% to below 40%. 3: 40% to below 60%. 4: 60% to below 80%. 5: 80% or more.

parameters.name: Contract or project materiality
parameters.formula_text: Contract Materiality % = Contract revenue, project value, or committed capital ÷ Entity annual revenue or adjusted capital × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more.

parameters.name: Shared-liability ratio
parameters.formula_text: Shared Liability % = Joint, guaranteed, or cross-default liability ÷ Total entity project exposure × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 10%. 2: 10% to below 25%. 3: 25% to below 50%. 4: 50% to below 80%. 5: 80% or more, or uncapped joint liability.

parameters.name: Project-delay ratio
parameters.formula_text: Project Delay % = Actual or forecast delayed days ÷ Original project duration days × 100.
parameters.rating_thresholds_text: 1: Below 5%. 2: 5% to below 10%. 3: 10% to below 20%. 4: 20% to below 35%. 5: 35% or more, project default, or termination.
